title: Switching-Activity Monitor
constraints: Count the bit toggles of `bus`: on each rising edge add popcount(bus ^ prev), where `prev` is the value of `bus` at the previous edge (0 after reset).

Windows are 16 edges long. On the 16th edge of a window, `activity <=` the toggle count of the whole window (including that edge), and the running count restarts. `hot <= activity_new > threshold` at the same edge. Both hold until the next window ends.
Synchronous reset clears everything (prev, counters, outputs).
hints: Dynamic power ∝ switching activity: this is what on-chip power monitors and DVFS governors measure.
A 4-bit window counter, an 8-bit accumulator, and a popcount of an 8-bit XOR.
Careful with the last edge: the value latched into `activity` must include that edge's toggles.
